[Story]
Li Chen gets second place in the school speech competition, and his good friend wins first place. Li Chen says to his teacher: "I am happy that my friend wins!" Li Chen says to his dad: "I am really disappointed, I want to win."

[Question]
Why does Li Chen feel both happy and disappointed?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He is happy because the competition ends, but disappointed because he thinks he does not speak well.
B. He does not care about the competition results, he just wants to make his dad happy.
C. He is happy that his friend wins, but disappointed with his own ranking.
D. He is happy that his friend wins, but disappointed that he does not get first place.
